Versus

full_judgment: 2. Syed Dastagir Hussain, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner has sought to submit that the suit tank having been recorded in the name of the defendant in S. A. Khatian, prima facie the plaintiffs are out of possession and as such the trial court as well as the lower appellate court rightly held that the suit being hit by the proviso to section 42 of the Specific Relief Act was not maintain-able as the plaintiffs did not seek for con-sequential relief either for confirmation or recovery of possession of the suit tank. But the learned Judge of the High Court Division erred in reversing the concurrent judgment of the courts below holding that the suit as framed is maintainable and the same is not hit by the proviso to section 42 of the specific relief Act.
